svg.title: Sheet 1 - Prepaid meter under test
svg.text: SHEET 1 OF 3 - PREPAID METER UNDER TEST (Arduino Mega 2560)
Coil circuit is separate from the mains contact wiring.
+12V rail: B1 (BATTERY 12 V), negative to GND.
LOGIC LINK TO VERIFIER (5 V -> 3.3 V)
1. Proteus: ALTERNATOR 328 V pk 50 Hz; TRAN-2P2S 400 H / 1 H, coupling 0.999;
ACS712 library part; RELAY 12 V coil; LAMP: Operating Voltage 230 V (100 W).
2. Flags with the same name are the same wire (LIVE, NEUTRAL, ISENSE, ...).
4. Mega TX1 (5 V) -> R8 / R9 divider -> ESP32 GPIO16 (3.3 V).
5. Keypad: rows are outputs, columns use INPUT_PULLUP.
6. Click SW1-SW3 during simulation to switch lamps on (1, 2 or 3 lamps).
7. R7 1 Mohm NEUTRAL-GND is a simulation reference (avoids floating-node errors).
8. Values and calculations: see the Value Sheet (04_Value_Sheet.xlsx).
Thesis: AI-Assisted External Meter Integrity Verification
Hardware not built: values from calculation, verify in simulation.
